title: Malicious code in twitch-stream-py (PyPI)
description: The 'twitch-stream-py' package on PyPI was found to be a malicious clone of a legitimate package. It contains obfuscated code that downloads and executes a remote script with malicious intent. The remote script was not accessible during analysis. The campaign was identified by Threx-code and is categorized as malware due to its behavior resembling infostealers.
